newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil rebounds at the close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil rebounds at the close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices rebounded in late trading and closed firmer on talk that Indonesia was in the market, looking for palm oil. Morning prices were down because of lack of demand and falls in Chicago soyoil futures. Trading was volatile. Dec futures fell to 1,130 low before rebounded.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices were also up due to an oversold market. Interest was confined to nearby CPO and palm olein.
Third month, December futures fell to a low of 1,130 ringgit before rebounded to close at 1,155 ringgit ($462.28) a tonne, up 16 ringgit.
Traders said immediate support level is 1,130 ringgit with resistance at 1,160 ringgit.
"The rise was expected as prices had fallen a lot in recent days," another dealer said.
Falls in Chicago soyoil futures overnight also eased prices initially but the market rebounded in late trading on shortcovering.
Lack of fresh tenders also weakened prices in early trade, traders said, expecting more tenders after India's STC bought some quantities of RBD palm olein earlier.
Physicals Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,175 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,160 to 1,170. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,170.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,160 with bids at 1,152.50 after trading at 1,145 and 1,155 ringgit.
Oct/Nov/Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,185 ringgit with bids at 1,175 after dealing at 1,165 and 1,170.
Oct (central) saw offers at 1,165 and bids at 1,155 and Nov (central) at 1,175 with bids at 1,160.
In refined products, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $505 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $502.50. Dec was traded at $494 and $492.50.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $545, Nov/Dec at $535, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $537.50. Oct was traded at $532.50 and Nov at $525.
Sep/Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50 and Nov/Dec at $407.50. Sep/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $337.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4985 ringgit)
